Specific absorption of Cyanobacteria with PC pigment (m^2/mg)

Species:   Microcystis aeruginosa
Source:    Absorption measurement from monoculture (grown under artifical white light). From the Culture Collection of Northern Poland of the Laboratory of Biochemical Ecology of Microorganisms from the University of Gdansk. 
Reference: Wojtasiewick, 2016. Bio-optical characterization of selected cyanobacteria strains present in marine and freshwater ecosystems.
Modifications by Loé:
- Smoothing of the spectrum with a savgol filter (window size = 21; polynomial order = 4)
